description:
What is This Part?
This is the Steering Wheel Center Cap for the 80′-88′ model Samurai
Center Emblem area on the Horn Button is the correct size to accept the Suzuki Emblem.
Currently is without any emblem or branding
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Steering Wheel Center Cover without emblem
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
